content: In Egypt the two keep watch by a khanaqah for a secluded dervish, who dies without receiving them; in Tabriz a woman subject to mystical attraction names them unprompted, describes their journey, and reveals that the Egyptian dervish refused them because of their faithlessness to the Baghdad shaykh. MK concludes that in this retelling they failed as Sufis through impatience and spiritual superficiality.
